description: The instance reports version v0.60.10, within the range affected by CVE-2026-72898: an unauthenticated attacker can inject SQL via /api/session/reset_password to read credentials and escalate to admin.
remediation: Upgrade Metabase to 60.17 or later; until then block the /api/session/reset_password endpoint at the network edge.
title: Metabase vulnerable to CVE-2026-72898 (unauthenticated SQL injection)
